skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic issues related to multinational corporate finance activities.
Analyze and manage financial risks faced by multinational corporations.
Evaluate international financial markets and their impact on multinational corporations.
Apply capital budgeting techniques to multinational investment projects.
Manage working capital effectively in multinational operations.
Calculate and optimize the cost of capital for multinational companies.
Develop short-term financing strategies for multinational operations.
Analyze foreign direct investments and mergers & acquisitions in global context.
Develop research and analytical skills for complex financial problems.
Demonstrate ability to work independently and manage personal time effectively.
Work collaboratively to solve complex financial problems in a team setting.
Show capacity for self-directed learning and continuous improvement.
